## Type of change

- [ ] Bug fix
- [ ] New feature
- [ ] Refactor or internal cleanup
- [ ] Documentation only

## Checklist

- [ ] `bun run typecheck` passes
- [ ] `bun test` passes
- [ ] Tests added or updated for the behavior change (tests live in `tests/`)
- [ ] `CHANGELOG.md` updated if the change is user-visible
- [ ] One change per commit, Conventional Commit message
- [ ] No secrets, tokens, or personal paths in the diff
- [ ] New dependencies (if any) are justified in the description
- [ ] Documentation updated (`README.md` / `README.id.md` when needed)
